title: KYC must be current
text: The applicant's KYC review must be current on the application date, else decline.

title: No recent adverse events
text: No adverse event recorded against the applicant in the 365 days before the application date, else decline.

title: Debt service coverage
text: DSCR at or above the approve line stands. Inside the judgment band it goes to review. Below the floor it declines.

title: Group exposure cap
text: Group exposure (the applicant plus businesses its owners control) must stay under the cap, else review.

title: Related delinquency blocks auto-approval
text: Any facility 60 or more days past due at a business where an owner of the applicant holds 25% or more blocks auto-approval.

title: Long-tenured declines need a person
text: Declining a customer of 10 or more years requires a person to confirm before the decision is filed.
